title: Infrastructure | St Vincent's Academy
content: . Special care is taken to ensure that the students have safe & comfortable passage while availing the School transport with the help of trained, highly experienced and responsible staff. All vehicles plying with the school have GPS & CCTV installed in them for regular monitoring of their movement in order to secure the safety of the children. HORSE RIDING, SWIMMING POOL AND HOSTEL FACILITIES Advanced HORSE RIDING, SWIMMING POOL AND HOSTEL FACILITIES. The School plans to introduce new co-curricular activities like horse riding and swimming pool along with Hostel facilities in the upcoming academic session for interested students. We believe the co-curricular activities would help our students in their holistic development

title: Infrastructure | St Vincent's Academy
content: . We believe the co-curricular activities would help our students in their holistic development. Cricket and Football Activities Cricket and Football Activities We are providing best Turf. Vincent Arena Sports Turf is redefining the sports culture of Burdwan as the town’s first and most premium sports destination. Built with FIFA-approved astro turf, it offers international-standard playing conditions for football, training sessions, and competitive matches. The arena features high-performance professional floodlights for safe and exciting night matches, along with premium amenities including a cafeteria for refreshments, ample parking space, comfortable player areas, secure boundary netting, and drinking water facilities

title: Infrastructure | St Vincent's Academy
content: . Designed for both professional athletes and casual players, Vincent Arena blends world-class infrastructure, convenience, and a vibrant sporting atmosphere—making it the preferred venue for tournaments, practice sessions, and friendly games in Burdwan. Playground Mordern Playground School playground memories beyond books and friends are the ones most of us will cherish forever. Playing at school will improve a child's coordination among so many things in life. However, today's kids are inclined to do more indoor activities without enjoying outside. Modern kids have slowly started avoiding playgrounds or playtime with increased exposure to video games and television. Playgrounds are the best places to develop creativity amongst children

title: Infrastructure | St Vincent's Academy
content: . Playgrounds are the best places to develop creativity amongst children. Most importantly, it develops vital cognitive and emotional skills that a child cannot acquire through leisure activities. St Vincent’s Academy houses a lush green playground and a dedicated play area with safe and enjoyable play/sports equipment for all the students. library Our Library Structure Today a reader, Tomorrow a leader – Margaret Fuller A School Library reflects the educational purposes and goals of the institution. The School Library plays a significant role in the education of the pupils by supporting the curriculum, nurturing the love for reading in a child, develop competence with information and enhance the students overall school experience

title: Infrastructure | St Vincent's Academy
content: . The Library is well equipped with a large number of latest and updated books of varied subjects, interest areas to generate and inculcate reading habits to widen the horizon of learning and create thinking. Books on subject matters ranging from literature to fiction and poetry to political science jostle for space in the School Library and the collection is regularly updated. Frontline newspapers, periodicals and journals keep the students updated on the latest development in current affairs and global thinking. Laboratories SCIENCE LABORATORIES (PHYSICS, CHEMISTRY AND BIOLOGY) Advanced Physics, compuChemistry and Bilology labs for practical learning

title: Infrastructure | St Vincent's Academy
content: . Working in a lab deepens comprehension, enhances critical thinking, hones problem-solving skills, builds teamwork and simultaneously acts as a bridge between theory and application. St. Vincent’s Academy houses well-equipped, spacious, separate laboratories, of Physics, Chemistry and Biology, which provide a much-needed break from textbook learning. All the Science Laboratories are well equipped with chemicals, instruments, devices and apparatus as required for conducting the practical classes. COMPUTER LABORATORY Keeping in mind the need and essentiality of technology in today’s generation the School has a fully modernized, state-of-the-art Computer Laboratory consisting of 40 Computers

title: Infrastructure | St Vincent's Academy
content: . All the computers are provided with High-Speed Internet Connectivity in order to provide the students with seamless Internet access for educational purposes. INFIRMARY At St. Vincent’s Academy, the health and well being of our students is of utmost importance. Keeping that in mind, the School has a 10-bed Infirmary to cater to all the medical needs of the students as well as the teachers. The Infirmary is well equipped with medical equipment, supplies and other necessary items to address the health needs of the members of the School. A qualified, trained and experienced nurse is available on campus 24x7 to care for the students and meet their medical requirements. Apart from a full-time nurse, the School also has visiting doctors available on call as and when required

title: Infrastructure | St Vincent's Academy
content: . Apart from a full-time nurse, the School also has visiting doctors available on call as and when required. The School also has affiliations/tie-ups with various reputed and well-established hospitals in Bardhaman. Existence of nearby structure should be given due consideration during

Here, the subsoil deposition is non cohesive in upper layer and lower layer. In
lower strata, the deposits are loose to medium to dense.

The upper 2.50 m soil deposit is very suspicious in character with very low
bearing capacity. So, the shallow foundation is to be placed at (-) 2.50 m
below EGL on normal deposit.
